You are given a positive integer N and two strings S and T, each of length N and consisting of lowercase English letters. Determine whether it is possible to make S identical to T by repeating the operation below any number of times. If it is possible, also find the number of operations required. No. If S and T are already identical, zero operations are needed.  
Input  
The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:  
N  
S  
T  
Output  
If it is possible to make S identical to T, print the number of operations required. Otherwise, print -1.  
Constraints  
- 1\leq N \leq 2\times 10^5  
- N is an integer.  
- Each of S and T is a string of length N, consisting of lowercase English letters.
